name: NoCodeList

sources.title: Homepage — Bubble-built 'Book of NoCode' catalogue, 300+ tools; page renders only with JS
SubmitMap platform walkthrough — submission types, account requirement, dofollow confirmation, DR 37

requirements: No-code angle required — catalogue is exclusively no-code tools, agencies, resources, and product stacks; a general SaaS with no no-code relevance is a rejection risk
Account required: 'To Submit, you have to be Logged In' — sign-up is email-link or email+password only; NO Google/GitHub SSO
Choose one of four submission types first (NoCode Software, NoCode Agency, NoCode Resource, NoCode Product Stack) — they are different forms, wrong choice means restarting
Product URL and a category from their ~100-category list
preparation: Email address for account creation (no SSO available — an agent cannot sign in with Google)
Decide the submission type up front
Category pick that fits the no-code taxonomy
workflow: Open https://nocodelist.co/submit (Bubble SPA — needs a real browser/JS)
Pick the submission type (Software / Agency / Resource / Product Stack)
Create an account via email link or password
Fill the type-specific form (name, URL, category, description, logo)
Submit for review; contact stefan@nocodelist.co for issues
watchFor: No single sign-on — account creation is email-based only
Listing links are plain anchors with ?ref=nocodelist appended — dofollow confirmed by third parties (DR ~37)
A 2023 third-party report noted broken signup/signin code — verify account creation works before investing in form details
Separate /sponsor route sells paid placement — listing itself is free
Site is a JS-only Bubble app — curl/fetch shows an empty shell
countsAsLive: The product appears as a card in the relevant nocodelist.co category with a link to the product domain
unknowns: Whether signup is currently functional (a 2023 report flagged it broken)
